newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGPC says Ras Gharib Feb price is Brent -$4.35.
newsitem.headline: EGPC says Ras Gharib Feb price is Brent -$4.35.

text.p: The state's Egyptian General Petroleum Corp (EGPC) said on Tuesday it was cutting the February price for its Ras Gharib blend by 15 U.S. cents a barrel to dated Brent -$4.35 from -$4.20 in January.
An EGPC official said earlier on Tuesday that the price would be dated Brent -$4.15, an increase of five cents.
EGPC cut the prices of all other grades by either 15 or 25 cents, according to an EGPC statement.
